title: Lauren Silverman Shares Glimpse of Her Luxury Summer with Fiancé Simon Cowell
text:
Lauren Silverman has shared a glimpse into her luxury summer with fiancé Simon Cowell as she posted a gallery of Instagram snaps on Wednesday. The couple's summer has become less about where they are and more about how they are, with Lauren describing it as 'barefoot more often than not, mornings that start outside, salt in our hair, sand in everything, workouts with an ocean view, camping under the stars, long walks, slow afternoons and conversations that somehow feel better without phones in our hands.'
Lauren Silverman has shared a glimpse into her luxury summer with fiancé Simon Cowell as she posted a gallery of Instagram snaps on Wednesday. The entrepreneur, 49, showed off her toned figure in a lilac sports bra and matching leggings as she hugged Simon during a hike in Malibu.
The couple's summer has become less about where they are and more about how they are, with Lauren describing it as 'barefoot more often than not, mornings that start outside, salt in our hair, sand in everything, workouts with an ocean view, camping under the stars, long walks, slow afternoons and conversations that somehow feel better without phones in our hands.
' Lauren has also shared photos of the couple dining out for dinner as well as enjoying a beach day, camping and an outdoor movie night with their son Eric, 12. In another photo, Simon looked completely relaxed as he soaked up the sun on an inflatable chair in a swimming pool. The shirtless Britain's Got Talent star was all smiles as he read a gossip magazine while working on his tan.
Lauren also shared photos of the couple's luxury birthday trip to Montecito with Simon and their son Eric, where they celebrated her 49th birthday at the billionaire's hotspot. The high-end restaurant Lucky's is a classic American steakhouse, which is regularly visited by celebs like Oprah Winfrey, Meghan Markle and Adam Levine. Alongside the post, Lauren gushed that her birthday weekend was 'everything I could have wished for' and thanked her fans for their birthday messages and kind words
